sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Syntax-only repair budget exhausted before semantic validation: Generator response must contain exactly one BEGIN_SHACL and END_SHACL marker

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: The conditional check must enforce exact classification equality, not merely require that firstYearIce is present. As written, an applicable ship with both nltl:firstYearIce and an additional conflicting nltl:iceTypeClassification value passes. Add a conditional violation for any classification value other than nltl:firstYearIce (or otherwise enforce a single classification value equal to nltl:firstYearIce), while preserving the existing applicability bounds and ship-owned paths.
